name: Ably Pub/Sub JavaScript SDK
solves: Provides a full-featured JavaScript client SDK for Ably's hosted realtime messaging platform, enabling pub/sub messaging, presence tracking, message history, push notifications, and LiveObjects state synchronization across browsers, Node.js, React, and React Native.
best_for: Apps requiring managed, globally-distributed realtime messaging with guaranteed delivery and ordering
React and Next.js projects needing built-in hooks (useChannel, usePresence, AblyProvider) for realtime features
Multi-platform projects targeting browser, Node.js, and React Native from a single SDK
Applications needing presence tracking, message history, and push notifications alongside pub/sub
Projects that need a tree-shakable modular SDK to minimize bundle size for browser deployments
skip_when: You need a self-hosted or open-source realtime server — Ably is a paid hosted service with no self-hosted option
Your project only needs simple WebSocket connections without pub/sub semantics or managed infrastructure
Budget is zero — Ably has a free tier but production usage requires a paid plan
You need peer-to-peer communication or CRDT-based collaborative editing rather than pub/sub messaging
You want to avoid vendor lock-in to a proprietary realtime messaging platform
